description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. US Federal Funds Rate, next FOMC meeting date + countdown, rate trend (hiking/holding/cutting), and full 2026 schedule. FRED public CSV + static calendar. Pairs with treasury-yields and credit-spreads.
name: fomc-tracker

current_rate_pct.description: FEDFUNDS monthly effective rate, latest available (%). Tracks target range midpoint.

meetings_remaining_year.description: FOMC meetings remaining in 2026, including the next one.

next_is_press_conf.description: True if the next meeting includes a press conference and SEP (dot plot).

next_meeting_date.description: End date of the next FOMC meeting (YYYY-MM-DD). Policy decision announced this day.

next_meeting_days_away.description: Calendar days until the next FOMC meeting end date.

rate_change_6m_pct.description: Rate change over last 6 months in percentage points (negative = cuts).

rate_date.description: Date of the latest FEDFUNDS observation (YYYY-MM-01, monthly series).

rate_trend.description: Rate direction over last 6 months: 'hiking', 'holding', or 'cutting'.
